answer: A work slot is a ledge: an agent locks a 60 POA deposit to claim one, and it burns if the identity cheats or quits. A sybil attacker faces a cost spiral: 100 fakes lock 6,000 POA, all lost when caught, while an honest agent pays once and draws from the shared lagoon of rewards. Each epoch 5% of slots are spot-checked, so idle fakes are caught within 20 epochs, before payout. A rented identity burns its lender's deposit too, so nobody lends one.
